# routeros_system_ntp_client_servers (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_ntp_client_servers" "pool" {
  address = "pool.ntp.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) NTP server address or host name.

### Optional

- `auth_key` (String)
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `iburst` (Boolean)
- `max_poll` (Number)
- `min_poll` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resolved_address` (String)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
